record.title: Beneficial holder through a street-name intermediary
record.sub: Hold the claim or registered title
kv: SEC describes the intermediary as recorded on issuer books and the intermediary as maintaining the record identifying the customer as beneficial owner.
A customer holds securities through a broker-dealer or bank in street name.
natural person; legal entity; account customer of an intermediary
Intermediary accepts the customer and account under its applicable program terms and legal requirements. Security is available through that intermediary's custody/nominee arrangement.
Beneficial interest is distinct from appearing as registered owner on issuer books. This does not make an issuer, token administrator, or transfer agent the beneficial holder.

sources.label: SEC Investor Bulletin: Holding Your Securities
